import os


def load(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    result = set()
    for line in data.split(b"\n"):
        addr = line.strip(b" \t\r\n\x0b\x0c").lower()
        if addr:
            result.add(addr)
    return result


def sort_key(addr):
    domain = addr.rpartition(b"@")[2]
    return (domain, addr)


def main():
    a = load(os.path.join("data", "a.txt"))
    b = load(os.path.join("data", "b.txt"))

    both = a & b
    a_only = a - b
    b_only = b - a

    merged = sorted(a | b, key=sort_key)

    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join("out", "merged.txt"), "wb") as f:
        for addr in merged:
            f.write(addr + b"\n")

    print("a-only: %d, both: %d, b-only: %d" % (len(a_only), len(both), len(b_only)))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
